description: Enable or disable one demand-curve assignment — the reversible off-switch: a disabled assignment stops shaping the item's forecast but keeps its configuration and provenance, and can be re-enabled at any time. Deleting assignments (or curves) is deliberately not available over MCP; use the app for that. Assignment ids come from list_demand_curve_assignments.

enabled.description: true = the assignment shapes the forecast; false = it is inert.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: set_demand_curve_assignment_enabled
title: Toggle Demand Curve Assignment
